########################################################################
# Setup library
########################################################################
include(GNUInstallDirs)

list(APPEND aff3ct_sources rate_matcher.cc turbo_codec.cc turbo_encoder_impl.cc
     turbo_decoder_impl.cc)

set(aff3ct_sources
    "${aff3ct_sources}"
    PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT aff3ct_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT aff3ct_sources)

add_library(gnuradio-aff3ct SHARED ${aff3ct_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-aff3ct gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime gnuradio::gnuradio-fec
                      aff3ct::aff3ct-shared-lib)
target_include_directories(
    gnuradio-aff3ct
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-aff3ct PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_aff3ct_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-aff3ct PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR
                                                    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
gr_library_foo(gnuradio-aff3ct)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")
